title: Seed lot register
description: Maintain identified physical seed lots, quantities and bounded source/variety references.

review.description: Correct a transcribed lot number while preserving physical lot identity, quantity and recorded source/variety references. Approval leaves the lot unchanged until explicit application.
review.label: lot number

scopeNotes: One optional variety and one optional source lot per lot; the local variety identities are synthetic examples.
Quantities are recorded in kilograms and do not represent a stock balance or current availability.
Certification, mixtures, multiple sources and operator registrations are outside this profile.
